notes.general_comments:
2396 candidates took this 30 question multiple-choice examination and the mean score was 19.3 which was
slightly lower than the mean score last year but almost identical to the mean score in 2014.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 2, 5, 9, 11, 13 and 30. These
questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of the
syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 7, 8, 12, and 14. These
questions were answered correctly by 50% or fewer candidates. The rest of the questions gave results which
were well within the levels expected.
